name: verify_accountAccount_audit_columns_by_id
note: account_account: create/write uid and date per row (mail/chatter and the record's metadata read), keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT id, create_uid, write_uid, create_date, write_date FROM account_account ORDER BY id

name: verify_accountAccount_scalar_listing
note: account_account: every int/string/bool column of every row as a list view reads it, keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT id, currency_id, parent_id, account_stock_variation_id, account_stock_expense_id, account_type, parent_path, note, active, reconcile, non_trade FROM account_account ORDER BY id

name: verify_accountAccount_embed_fanout_by_parent
note: account_account: per-parent count of each embedded array (account_account_res_company_rel, account_account_account_tag, account_account_tax_default_rel) against the child-row count, keyed by id
source_sql: SELECT r.id, COALESCE(e0.n, 0) AS n_rescompanyrel, COALESCE(e1.n, 0) AS n_accounttag, COALESCE(e2.n, 0) AS n_taxdefaultrel FROM account_account r LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_account_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM account_account_res_company_rel GROUP BY account_account_id) e0 ON e0.pid = r.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_account_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM account_account_account_tag GROUP BY account_account_id) e1 ON e1.pid = r.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id AS pid, COUNT(*) AS n FROM account_account_tax_default_rel GROUP BY account_id) e2 ON e2.pid = r.id ORDER BY r.id
